review_summary: Comprehensive independent verification of 9702_m17_42 Question 7 across all 3 leaves (a, b(i), b(ii)). Question text, circuit diagram (Fig. 7.2), calibration graph (Fig. 7.1), and 10-mark structure faithfully match the original QP (pages 14-15) and official MS (pages 6-7). Structural description in (a) correctly evaluates fine wire/foil grid and insulating envelope (3 marks). Potential divider calculation in (b)(i) rigorously yields R = 306.0 ohm, Delta R = 6.0 ohm, and Delta L = 8.0 x 10^-5 m (3 marks). Comparator operational amplifier analysis in (b)(ii) accurately tracks strain increase causing R to rise, V+ (point A) to drop below V- (2.00 V), negative saturation of the op-amp output to -5 V, and forward-biasing of diode X (4 marks). Hint scaffolding provides >=2 progressive non-revealing hints per leaf, walkthroughs have >=2 complete steps, and all AI rubrics align with curriculum outcomes (9702_t10_m03_o04, 9702_t10_m03_o01, 9702_t10_m01_o02).
